sections.shortTitle: Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service Constitution Functions and Powers Amendment Ordinance 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 2011
ORDINANCE II OF 2011
SINDH CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE
(CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS)
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2011
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh
Criminal Prosecution
Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers)
Act, 2009
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd May, 2011]
No. S.LEGIS:1(2)/2011, dated 2-5-2011.--The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general
information:--
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to
amend the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service
(Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the
Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Sindh Criminal
Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers (Amendment) Ordinance,
2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
